title: Excellent strainer but only half the functionality works as designed
text:
Excellent strainer but only half the functionality works as designed. I ordered this strainer thinking it was 5 inches around because I was looking for a very small strainer. However, by 5 inches it means across the top at the widest point. Therefore, this is larger than I expected but that is my mistake.

The strainer itself is wonderful. I can wash rice, millet, couscous, etc. without loosing the grains through the mesh. It is also good for washing berries, grapes, etc. However, what I do not like is that only half of this strainer's functionality works. What I mean by this is that there is a "hook" on top that goes over a bowl for hands-free operation. This only works if there is already food in the stranger which negates the purpose of that feature.  When I go to strain something, the strainer starts out empty. If I hook this over a bowl, it immediately tips out of the bowl and onto its handle because the handle is too heavy. This is a negative for me and half the functionality of this strainer is non-existent as a result.

As long as one does not want that "over-the-bowl" feature, then this strainer is great but the cost is too high just to use for straining without the functionality of that feature.

A limited lifetime warranty is included.
